cl.x: Provide SikaInject®-867 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2024, Version 01.01).
SikaInject®-867 is a thixotropic, high yield, and shrinkage compensated grout used for placement of cable and rock bolts in tunnels and underground mines

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: SikaInject®-867 may only be used by experienced professionals.
s: SikaInject®-867 is particularly suitable as a grout used for the encapsulation of roof bolts and cable anchors where the “top-down” grouting method is preferred.
SikaInject®-867 has been specially developed to give a high yield (volume) of grout without segregation or bleed whilst providing excellent compressive strengths.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Equipment
cl.x: For best results, a high mechanical shear mixer or a paddle mixer should be used. The grout pump must have accurate water dosing capabilities.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing
s: SikaInject®-867 is supplied ready to use; requiring only the addition of potable water.

Fill the mixer with the correct amount of water that matches the number of SikaInject®-867 bags. As a guide, use 6.0 - 7.5L of water per 20 kg bag of SikaInject®-867 grout for a thixotropic mixture. The actual amount of water required will depend on the desired consistency of the grout mixture and the grout pump available. Do not exceed the amount of water recommended for obtaining thixotropic mixtures. Start the mixer after adding the required amount of water. Slowly add SikaInject®-867 grout powder. Continue mixing until a thick, creamy, no-lump consistency is obtained. Discard any grout mixture that has been left unattended for more than 60 minutes. Do not retemper.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: As with all grouting operations, it is essential to systematically clean the pump and grout lines with clean water. This should be done immediately after completion of grouting operations. If the grouting operations delay for more than an hour, the batched grout mixture should be discarded, and the pump and grout lines cleaned.
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
